messages:
sam: FYI: audit-sink reported 403s for vault namespace 'payments' at ~14:03 UTC after last night's RBAC tidy. noticed a small gap (14:03-14:09).

maya: i removed a legacy SA binding earlier. did that affect the sink writer?

oliver: looks likely. which SA writes the sink? audit-bot, can you confirm?

audit-bot: sink-writer serviceAccount: svc-audit-writer@redwood-project had analytics-role removed at 13:58 UTC.

sam: backup plan: rehydrate from wrapped backups under gs://redwood-audit-backups/payments/*.enc, decrypt with kms-ops, import to vault dry-run first.

maya: grant request: need short-lived kms.decrypt for serviceAccount:kms-ops to unwrap only for this job. i'll apply with TTL 10m.

oliver: also scan the unwrapped blobs for any plaintext tokens and flag anything with pattern "vault.token". if found, rotate affected service tokens immediately.

vault-bot: import dry-run results: 98 events available, 1 truncated file (14:05) flagged.

sam: rotate plan executed: rotated svc/payments-fetcher token, updated k8s secret and restarted deployment.

maya: perms revoked for kms-ops. filing follow-up ticket to add alert when audit sink ACLs change.

sam: created incident INC-2026-078, added owners (maya, oliver). closing this thread once postmortem doc linked.
